description:
[Items] Everything about one item in one call. The item page's whole bundle, trimmed for reading, plus every other dataset that mentions the item:
`item` (name, description, category, stack size, despawn), `recipe`, `craft_time` (seconds at workbench level 1,
and with one/two levels above), `blueprint_costs` (research), `tech_tree` (where it sits and what it costs in
research items), `recycle_table`, `vending` (NPC shops selling it / taking it), `loot_sources` (the 15 best
chances), `used_in`, `weapon` (damage, fire rate, magazine, range - guns), `explosive` (splash radius and hits per
building grade - explosives), `fishing` (as a catch or as bait), `survival` (spoilage, compost value, armour
insert stats/slots, pet stats, mission rewards, keycard/fuse puzzles), `design_notes` (lore from The Art of Rust),
`skins` (the 5 priciest of `skins_total`) and `tools` - follow-up tools for more. Cached item bundle + pure lookups. Everything about one item in one call - prefer it over several lookups. Shortnames via search.

shortname.description: The item's shortname (find it with `/search` or `/items/search`).

name: get_item_full
